title: Tangent sheaf along a smooth section is the pullback tangent sheaf
statement: Let f:X\to S be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and e:S\to X a section, so f\circ e=id_S. Let Omega be the cotangent sheaf, the sheafification of the relative Kahler differential presheaf [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf]. Define T=\mathcal Hom(Omega,O_X) and T_e=\mathcal Hom(e^*Omega,O_S). Then T_e\cong e^*T.

source.place: TangentSpace original proof sketch, completed using Tags 02G1 and 0FNV.

proof.text: The cotangentSheaf definition and the library relativeDifferentials definition are definitionally equal: both sheafify relativeDifferentials of the adjoint structure-ring map. Use this equality and finite local freeness of smooth relative differentials.

Apply pullback compatibility of duals to relativeDifferentials and e, and invert the resulting isomorphism. Unfold tangentSheafAlong and tangentSheaf to identify its endpoints. The section equation is unnecessary for this stronger compatibility, but its binder is retained unchanged.
